title: Boss Challenge: Clean Water for Everyone
summary: Put every separation method together to make dirty water safe to drink, from a village well to Bengaluru's water supply.

ib.note: Unit summative-style task: Criterion D (impacts of science) and B

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 9: Methods of Separation in Everyday Life (loading with alum, filtration)
Exploration (2026) Ch 5: Exploring Mixtures and their Separation (coagulation with alum, distillation)

objectives: I can describe the stages of water treatment: screening, sedimentation with alum, filtration and disinfection.
I can explain why the stages must happen in that order.
I can explain why clear water is not always safe water.
I can evaluate different ways of providing safe water to a community.
misconceptions: Clear water is always safe to drink.
Filtering removes germs and dissolved substances.
Distillation is the best way to clean water for a whole city.
